dct_description_sm:
Montreal manages a fleet of road structures for which the City is partially or completely responsible for their inspections. The set presents the inventory of road structures on the territory, including also the general condition index (ICG).

Road structures include bridges, footbridges, noise barriers, tunnels, retaining walls, snow docks, and culverts.

WARNING: This data is published to provide a better understanding of the City's assets, but should under no circumstances be used for engineering calculations.**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
